items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well let's see, do you know much about Ward Pinkert's association with Jelly Roll? [INTERVIEWER] No I don't. I know that they had been friends for a long while...

ctx.x: '63 yeah, it wasn't too long ago.
Well let's see, do you know much about Ward Pinkert's association with Jelly Roll?

No I don't. I know that they had been friends for a long while, much longer than I was friends with Jelly Roll, because prior to this session that I made with him, he had been making records with Jelly Roll, so I imagine their acquaintance was long lived.
